discussion.body: Act 3 storyboard. Locations: west crossing, Bengenia pale court, Temple of Mist. Join: Seris (FEAT-031). Beats: isle in standing fog; Velith hosts the party as pilgrims; Mist dungeon yields Veil Sigil without clearing the weather; Seris refuses the Archon's prayer; unmask, Velith is smothering the other temples so only Mist remains. Major variation: the wipe. Mist cannot be cleared. If Velith overdraws, or if the party forces a 'clear the mist' ritual, Bengenia as a region is destroyed. That matches the existing FEAT-003 discussion. Death crisis: Seris dies if she stays to hold the veil during the wipe. If she already walks with the party she can live. Contingency: Veil Sigil recoverable from the ruin; later west travel is a dead sea of fog and wrecks, not a town hub. This does not fork the ending. Frames: crossing, pale court, mist sanctum, unmask, optional wipe.
